I got the FISP coupon this year, so I will apply one 50kg bag of NPK and one 50kg bag of urea to my 0.64 hectare plot, and I will plant the hybrid seed that came with it because last season the cobs were much bigger where I used fertilizer. I will also spread manure from my chickens and goats since I own this land and I want the soil to stay strong. I will hire two workers for four days to help with planting so we finish before the rains, but my family will do all the weeding and harvesting ourselves, which will take about 90 days. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, and anyway the plot is small enough to weed by hand.
